models.summary: A folding city-bike family for combining riding with compact storage and public transport.

facts.label: Current buyer-guide gear options
facts.value: 4-speed or 12-speed; confirmed on separately named product pages

models.caveat: Named gear options are not a complete history of C Line builds. Detailed 4-speed component fields are internally inconsistent, so fork and hub details are not added. Verify configuration-specific measurements and components with Brompton.

conflicts.note: A single family-wide folded size has been withdrawn: family and specific-build pages differ. Confirm the exact handlebar, seatpost and rack configuration before relying on storage dimensions.

models.resolution_note: Gear-option display resolved by scope: current buyer guidance and named products establish 4-speed and 12-speed options. Mixed family-page copy still mentions 2/6/12 and is not treated as current availability for every generation.

models.summary: An endurance road family; the checked 2025 Advanced 1 pairs a composite chassis with electronic shifting.

conflicts.note: Both the US 2025 product page and matching PDF list 38 mm and 40 mm. Manufacturer confirmation is required; neither value is accepted as a resolved maximum.

models.resolution_note: The exact US 2025 product page repeats the PDF discrepancy: 38 mm in descriptive/Extras text and 40 mm in Max Tire Clearance. Neither source explicitly supersedes the other. Maximum clearance remains unknown pending manufacturer clarification; no larger-tire recommendation is made.
